scope: Correctness and cancellation only; no real-consumer performance measurement. Fixtures and checks excluded from latency. Every sample must actually cancel with unchanged output headers and correct partial bounds.
hook: Late-split cases request cancellation immediately before first-split prefix materialization; baseline at corresponding first split. No-split cancels inside second Err after reading nil; third Err returns cancellation.
acceptance: All seven phases and independent evidence review required. No timing result substitutes for correctness or real-consumer benefit.
resources: 4GiB hard; zero swap;3GiB monitored stop;CPU2;PIDs64;tmpfs64MiB;1MiB output;64KiB report;22minute controller;24minute workflow;serial stage cleanup.
slot: Parent-assigned serial hosted only. No dispatch authorization.

heap.interpretation: Record raw capacities and MemStats plus signed baseline-relative paired retained HeapAlloc/HeapInuse deltas after one/two GC. Any candidate retention increase requires explicit tradeoff review; no automatic optimization acceptance. Artificial exact/spare capacity fixtures are diagnostics, not real-consumer savings.
